jihad: A jihad is a personal fight with yourself to become a better person.
A jihad is a holy war by Muslims to stop people from keeping down other people by force.
The Muslims have started a jihad against the Israelis.
jig: A jig is a light, quick musical dance or movement.
A jig is a device that is used in manufacturing or woodworking and is used to control the location and movement of the workpiece.
jilt: To not marry, to break an engagement suddenly, to leave one standing at the altar.
John has warned Jill he will jilt her if she doesn't stop seeing Rory.
jingle: A jingle is a short tune (usually with lyrics) that is used for advertising purposes.
I cannot get the jingle for Brewmeister Beer out of my head!
To jingle is when metal or glass clashes together and causes a sound.
I heard the keys on his ring jingle as he approached the door.
jiggle: A jiggle is a weak, shaking movement.
Give the key a jiggle and see if it opens.
If you jiggle something, you shake it gently.
Jiggle the handle and see if the water stops.
If something jiggles, it shakes gently.
The jelly jiggled in the bowl for a few moments after it was set down.
jiffy: A jiffy is a very short time.
I'll be there in a jiffy.
jigsaw: A jigsaw is a saw with a fine and narrow blade which can be used to cut curves in wood or metal.
jiggly: If something is jiggly, it jiggles.
jibe: A jibe is an insulting or mocking remark.
If you jibe, you make insulting or mocking remarks.
jimmy: A jimmy is a crowbar used by burglars to open windows and doors.
If you jimmy a lock, you pry it open with something such as a crowbar.
jitter: A jitter is a nervous action.
A jitter is an unwanted movement of one or more signal characteristics.
If person jitters, they act nervously.
If a computer jitters, it suffers from jitter.
jittery: A jittery person is someone who is tense or nervous.
A jittery display has unwanted movement of one or more signal characteristics.
jiangsu: Jiangsu is a province in China.
